title: descurainia incisa var. leptophylla
intro: Descurainia incisa var. leptophylla, commonly known as Western needle spurge, is a plant species native to North America. This plant is used in traditional medicine, where it is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Western needle spurge include analgesia, anti-edema, and wound healing, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins. The bioactive constituents of Western needle spurge have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
